attchmntText: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The company reported a standalone profit of 48.37 lakhs for the quarter, compared to a loss of 67.75 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year, the standalone result was a loss of 1,093.31 lakhs versus a loss of 968.73 lakhs previously. Consolidated results showed a loss of 33.04 lakhs for the quarter and a loss of 1,193.52 lakhs for the half year. The board also noted the company's name change from Sanginita Chemicals Limited to Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited, effective August 20, 2026. The financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors.

attchmntText: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Agastya Energy and Infrastructure Limited has announced the voting results for resolutions passed via postal ballot on November 13, 2026. The company approved two ordinary resolutions regarding material related party transactions. Resolution one, concerning transactions with IMC Solar BDN LLP, was passed with 78.1376 percent of votes polled in favor. Resolution two, concerning transactions with BN Up Kusum Solar1 Private Limited, was also passed with 78.1398 percent of votes polled in favor. The record date for these votes was October 9, 2026. The scrutinizer for the process was Nishant Rana of Rana & Associates. The e-voting period ran from October 15, 2026, to November 13, 2026.
